description: Retrieve a previously remembered value by key. Prerequisite: none. Effect: the sidecar looks up `key` in its in-memory store and returns `{found: true, value: <stored>}` if present or `{found: false}` if the key was never set (or was set before a sidecar restart — memory does not survive restart in this scope). Cost: none. Distinguishes 'stored null' from 'never set': a key stored with value=null returns `{found: true, value: null}`, while a never-stored key returns `{found: false}` with no value field. NOT a FreeSO wire action — agent-local only, no perception emission, no PDU. Sibling of `remember`. To observe what *other* Sims said or did, use perception feed + recall of your own notes.

args.name: key
args.description: The key to look up. Must match a prior remember's key exactly (case-sensitive).
